name: Common Ground
thesis: An explorable field map lets Raygen’s machines, tools, and Hack Club contributions reveal who he is through their real connections.
interaction: Select a place to illuminate its connecting route and reveal a short footnote; arrow keys move between places, and the map becomes a readable vertical trail on mobile.
why: Actual printer renders and official Hack Club artwork inhabit a personal atlas with plum-black ground, citron routes, and outsized lettering instead of conventional portfolio sections.
